# Priority Lock and Security

> Scheduled locksmith and door hardware company in Tampa, Florida, founded June 2021, owner operated, insured. Most work is in and around Ybor City, about 30 minutes in any direction. Text 813-421-4787 or email steven@prioritylocks.com, Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM. A real person texts back a ballpark within minutes during business hours.

## Prices (updated November 2026)
- Homes: $125 the first hour, trip included, then $100 an hour, billed in quarter hours.
- Businesses: $125 an hour, trip in the first hour.
- Remote support: from $50 an hour. Key copies: $3 each.
- Parts priced on the quote before work starts. Estimates are free. Deposits only when parts are over $500.
- Typical: a home rekey of up to about 4 locks usually fits in the first hour ($125); 5 to 8 locks about 1 to 1.5 hours ($125 to $175).

## Services
- [Rekey a house](https://prioritylocks.com/services#rekey): old keys stop working; about 10 to 15 minutes a lock.
- [Lock and deadbolt replacement](https://prioritylocks.com/services#locks): about 20 to 45 minutes a door, plus the lock.
- [Door adjustment and hinges](https://prioritylocks.com/services#doors): about 30 to 60 minutes a door; no frame work.
- [Door closers](https://prioritylocks.com/services#closers): adjust 15 to 30 minutes; replace 1 to 2 hours plus the closer.
- [Panic bars and exit hardware](https://prioritylocks.com/services#exit): install about 2 to 3 hours plus the device.
- [Storefront door hardware](https://prioritylocks.com/services#storefront): about 30 to 60 minutes.
- [Commercial rekeys and tenant turnover](https://prioritylocks.com/services#turnover): about 15 minutes a lock; one price by door count.
- [Master key systems and key control](https://prioritylocks.com/services#master): free design visit, then about 15 to 20 minutes a door.
- [Pricing](https://prioritylocks.com/pricing)

## Who we serve
Homeowners and new home buyers, renters and landlords, property managers, building owners and investors, restaurants, shops, offices, churches, schools, clinics, warehouses and HOAs.

## What we do not do
Car keys and car lockouts, safes, door frames, after hours or 24 hour emergency calls, access control, cameras or alarms.
